_description: Reusable template. Each instance is a separate routine in Anthropic's cloud, identified by its source repo (the entry in `sources` that is not Harrison-Blair/ai-reports). Per-instance routine_id and manage_url are not stored locally — list them via the RemoteTrigger 'list' action or at https://claude.ai/code/routines.
_instantiation: 2. Replace <SOURCE_REPO_URL> with the full https github URL of the source repo.
3. Generate a fresh lowercase v4 UUID and put it at job_config.ccr.events[0].data.uuid.
4. Inline prompt.md verbatim into job_config.ccr.events[0].data.message.content; drop the content_source field.
name: <DISPLAY_NAME>
schedule_note: Daily at 04:00 UTC. No DST conversion needed (UTC-anchored).
notes: Listed first in `sources` so it's the primary working directory; the source repo is listed second to ensure the env's GitHub token (Claude app installation token) covers it.
Prompt is repo-agnostic — Step 0 discovers source vs destination by inspecting checked-out git remotes, so swapping the source URL is the only change between instances.
Source repo must have the Claude GitHub App installed if it is private (read scope sufficient).
Branch per instance: `ai-reports/<source-repo-name>/daily-summary`. Do not collapse to a shared branch — concurrent routines would race.
Recommend a manual first run via RemoteTrigger {action:'run'} after creation to verify auth scope and discovery against the actual cloud-env layout.
